distinctness.explanation: Band distance is RMS dB difference between six energy fractions, each floored at -50 dB relative to total. Envelope distance is RMS feature difference divided by each feature's measured interquartile range with stated precision floors. Thresholds equal the measured old hall/service distances, with 1 dB band and 0.25 envelope minima preventing rounding from deciding sameness. Combined distance is sqrt((band/threshold)^2 + (envelope/threshold)^2)/sqrt(2); <=1 flags a new pair if neither component exceeds 1.25 thresholds. Measured current 10th/50th/90th pair percentiles show where this owner's yardstick lies in the new data. This is an acoustic similarity screen; perceptual distinctness is not listening verified.
